 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Mitchell Green, the founder of Lead Edge Capital. When I think about Lead Edge, I sort of think about this giant money machine that Mitchell and his two partners have designed over the last 15+ years to make remarkably consistent investment returns for their clients. They have all sorts of unique aspects to the machine that they've built, whether that's their collection of LPs, their 8-point criteria for how they select companies, the way they do cold calls, the way they construct their portfolio.

 This is just a totally different way of approaching markets. They're trying to hit singles and doubles and deliver very consistent returns. Mitchell says it's really important in life to be memorable. That's just a great simple thing that you can do. I think you'll find listening to Mitchell today and him talk about his entire machine and the firm that he's built, that he himself is extremely memorable. I hope you enjoy learning about his business.
